items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: Then after the other trumpet player come in, Eddie Mullins, he made a couple of things.

ctx.x: Who did the arrangements mostly for the band at that time?

At the time I come there it was Andy Gibson was doing mostly everything, in '41. Then pretty soon he got Buster Harding, and Buster stayed with him all through the things, and every now and then he'd have somebody else to make an arrangement, like Chappie Willett would make something sometimes, or Benny Carter had some things in the book, but it was made before I got there, you know. Or he'd find somebody. But he always liked to have an arranger, because like you're doing that picture, "Stormy Weather," that was…
Well, I always thought Andy Gibson was really very talented. I don't think he ever got the credit he should have gotten.
